data.abstract: This paper investigates a robust stochastic Stackelberg reinsurance differential game between an insurer and a reinsurer under Bayesian learning and ambiguity aversion. In the reinsurance contracting problem, the insurer's claim risk follows a diffusion model, and the premium consists of an observable factor and an unobservable factor that is dynamically estimated via Bayesian learning. Under the expected utility maximization criterion, we derive closed-form solutions for the insurer's robust optimal risk retention level, the reinsurer's robust optimal reinsurance price, and the corresponding optimal value functions. The effects of learning and ambiguity aversion on the equilibrium strategies are then analyzed. Several numerical examples are provided to illustrate the theoretical results and their economic implications. We show that Bayesian learning generates an additional hedging demand, the sign of which depends on the interplay among Bayesian filtering, claim–factor correlations, and ambiguity aversion. The ambiguity aversion of the insurer and the reinsurer affects equilibrium risk sharing asymmetrically.

data.abstract: The alternating direction method of multipliers (ADMM) is widely recognized as an efficient approach for composite optimization problems in Euclidean spaces. Although ADMM has recently been extended to the Riemannian setting, most existing variants are limited to two-block structures, thereby restricting their practical applicability and computational efficiency. This talk considers a class of nonconvex, nonsmooth, non-Lipschitz composite optimization problems on Riemannian manifolds, for which we develop a three-block Riemannian ADMM (TRADMM) by incorporating linearly coupled constraints into the reformulation. TRADMM employs computationally inexpensive closed-form updates in each iteration, thereby avoiding costly inner iterations and significantly reducing the total computational cost. The boundedness of the Lagrange multipliers is guaranteed through an adaptive update of the dual stepsize together with Moreau envelope smoothing. We analyze the iteration complexity of the proposed algorithm for finding an $\epsilon$-stationary point under mild assumptions. Numerical experiments on unsupervised feature selection show that the proposed method outperforms the compared methods in terms of computational efficiency.

data.abstract: In this talk, we are committed to the study of generalized difference gap (D-gap) functions and error bounds for hemivariational inequalities in Hilbert spaces. By introducing a new gap function, we define a generalized D-gap function for the hemivariational inequality considered, for which we investigate the local Lipschitz continuity and coercivity. Then, some error bound results for the generalized D-gap function are established and the relationship between the solution to the hemivariational inequality and the stationary point of the generalized D-gap function is discussed. Finally, we construct a descent algorithm for solving the hemivariational inequality based on the generalized D-gap function and further prove a convergence result for the algorithm.

data.abstract: This paper studies constrained bilevel optimization problems for which the lower-level problem may fail to satisfy strong constraint qualifications, such as the Mangasarian--Fromovitz Constraint Qualification (MFCQ). We introduce BLP-AKKT, a new sequential optimality condition formulated directly for constrained bilevel optimization rather than through an MPEC reformulation. Under the Polyak--Lojasiewicz constraint qualification (PLCQ) imposed on the lower-level problem, we establish the necessity of BLP-AKKT for local optimality. Building on this condition, we develop a modular single-loop algorithmic framework and prove that every feasible accumulation point generated by algorithms within this framework satisfies BLP-AKKT. Using the AKKT residual as a stationarity measure, we further derive convergence rate guarantees for two specific instances: one based on gradient-descent updates and the other on a recursive momentum technique. Numerical experiments on synthetic instances and instances from the Bilevel Optimization LIBrary (BOLIB) demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed algorithms compared with MPEC-based relaxation methods and value function-based methods.

data.abstract: Simple games in partition function form are used to model voting situations where a coalition being winning or losing might depend on the way players outside that coalition organize themselves. In this lecture, we consider plurality voting games being simple games in partition function form such that in every partition there is at least one winning coalition. Such a game is said to be weighted if it is possible to assign weights to the players such that a winning coalition in a partition is always one which maximizes the sum of the weights of its members over all coalitions in the partition. A plurality game is decisive if in every partition there is exactly one winning coalition. In van den Brink et al. (2021) we show that plurality games need not be weighted, even not when they are decisive. We prove that (i) decisive plurality games with at most four players, (ii) majority games with an arbitrary number of players, and (iii) decisive plurality games that exhibit some kind of symmetry, are weighted. Complete characterizations of the winning coalitions in the corresponding partitions are provided. In our follow up article, van den Brink et al. (2025), we introduce an equal impact power index for this class of games and provide an axiomatic characterization. This power index is based on equal weight for every partition, equal weight for every winning coalition in a partition, and equal weight for each player in a winning coalition. Since some of our axioms are conditioned on the power impact of losing coalitions becoming winning in a partition, our characterization depends on a new result showing the existence of such elementary transitions between plurality games in terms of single embedded winning coalitions. The axioms restrict the impact of such transitions on the power of different types of players.

data.abstract: 中性原子阵列已成为量子计算、量子模拟和量子精密测量的重要平台。其中，类碱土原子展现出长相干时间、高保真度量子门和擦除误差转化等独特优势，但其阵列规模长期落后于碱金属原子。我们在光镊阵列中成功俘获2400个镱-174原子，并实现了83.5(1)%的单原子增强装载效率，打破碱土金属原子光镊阵列规模纪录。我们进一步发现装载效率在数十至数千个原子阵列规模范围内均能保持稳定，并且在不同原子间势能条件下均具有鲁棒性，验证了该方法的可扩展性和广泛使用下。为实现基于镱-174阵列的实现通用量子计算机，我们提出用基态-钟态编码量子比特编码，预期可实现保真度为99.9%的双量子比特门。本研究为实现基于类碱土原子的大规模量子计算迈出了关键一步。

data.abstract: This work employs a policy iteration reinforcement learning (RL) method to investigate continuous-time mean-field linear quadratic problems over an infinite horizon. The drift and diffusion terms in the dynamics involve the state as well as the control. The stability and convergence of the RL algorithm are examined using a Lyapunov Recursion. Instead of solving a pair of coupled Riccati equations, the RL technique focuses on strengthening an auxiliary function and the cost functional as the objective functions and updating the new policy to compute the optimal control via state trajectories. A numerical example sheds light on the established theoretical results.

data.abstract: Motivated by the March 2023 USDC de-pegging, this paper explains how fully reserved stablecoins can experience structural runs by shifting the analytical focus from static solvency to the dynamic execution capacity of redemption infrastructure. Using a discrete-time DSGE model featuring heterogeneous households, balance-sheet-constrained arbitrageurs, and physical settlement bottlenecks, we demonstrate that stablecoin fragility stems from an endogenous feedback loop linking redemption frictions, intermediary capital depletion, and settlement congestion rather than insufficient reserves. We highlight three key findings: first, mere expectations of future network congestion generate a liquidity-eroding "ghost tax" even during tranquil periods; second, gradual intermediary capital depletion pushes the system toward a "stability cliff," abruptly activating dormant whale balances and triggering a nonlinear collapse characterized by asymmetric hysteresis; third, limited physical execution capacity ultimately converts short-term redemption pressure into persistent secondary-market discounts by severing cross-market integration. Consequently, current regulations fixated on stock-based reserve adequacy are insufficient; ensuring true systemic resilience requires flow-based stress testing of physical settlement speeds and intermediary capacity.

data.abstract: This talk is concerned with Burgers equation with singular viscosity and singular flux. We realize that, when the singularity for flux is less than the singularity of viscosity, there exists smooth viscous shock wave, otherwise the shock wave does not exist. The main issue is to show the stability of these shock waves. To overcome the singularities caused by viscosity and flux, we use the weighted energy method, where the selection of weights are technical and play a crucial role in the proof. This talk is based on a series of studies joint with Dr. Xiaowen Li, Prof. Jingyu Li, Prof. Jean-Christophe Nave, Prof. Wancheng Sheng, and Dr. Shufang Xu.

data.abstract: 近年来,我国宏观税负的持续性下降,已成为经济发展中的重要结构性现象,关乎如何保持合理的宏观税负水平。准确刻画、深入剖析该重要事实的典型特征、演进逻辑与驱动因素,在学理和实践层面都具有重要意义。研究表明,中国新一轮宏观税负的下降并非阶段性现象,而是由大规模减税政策、价格水平走低、中长期结构转型与税制适应性不足共同作用形成的趋势性规律;尤为值得关注的是,既有的税制职能短板,使宏观税负在持续承压下缺乏稳定支撑。基于中国税制运行与经济转型之间的深层互动逻辑,稳定宏观税负不应是对短期财政收缩的被动应对,而应是对税制功能结构的系统性回应与再平衡。未来的税制改革需更加注重前瞻性与适应性,通过推进税制结构优化,完善收入分配职能,在公平性与可持续性之间实现新的均衡。

data.abstract: We propose a new penalty, the springback penalty, for constructing models to recover an unknown signal from incomplete and inaccurate measurements. Mathematically, the springback penalty is a weakly convex function. It bears various theoretical and computational advantages of both the benchmark convex penalty and many of its non-convex surrogates that have been well studied in the literature. We establish the exact and stable recovery theory for the recovery model using the springback penalty for both sparse and nearly sparse signals, respectively, and derive an easily implementable diﬀerence-of-convex algorithm. In particular, we show its theoretical superiority to some existing models with a sharper recovery bound for some scenarios where the level of measurement noise is large or the amount of measurements is limited. We also demonstrate its numerical robustness regardless of the varying coherence of the sensing matrix. The springback penalty is particularly favorable for the scenario where the incomplete and inaccurate measurements are collected by coherence-hidden or -static sensing hardware due to its theoretical guarantee of recovery with severe measurements, computational tractability, and numerical robustness for ill-conditioned sensing matrices.

data.abstract: 本研究针对大规模张量数据低秩表示方法中存在的计算效率低下与噪声鲁棒性不足的问题,提出了一种基于三因子分解与非凸正则化的快速鲁棒张量低秩表示方法。本研究通过一种三因子分解策略,将待求解的大型系数张量表示为三个较小张量的变换乘积,从而将计算负担转移到一个紧凑的核心张量上,显著降低了模型优化的计算复杂度。为提升低秩恢复的紧致性,本研究在核心张量上采用了一种基于双核因子化的非凸Schatten-½型正则化策略。同时,为有效处理混合噪声,模型联合采用ℓ₁范数建模稀疏异常值,并利用非凸ℓ₂,½范数刻画样本级稠密扰动。在统一的变换张量代数框架下,本研究分别实现了基于离散傅里叶变换与离散余弦变换的两种具体方案,并对其进行了系统性的实证比较。在合成与真实数据集上的实验表明,所提方法在子空间聚类与去噪任务上均能取得优越的性能,同时大幅减少了运行时间,并揭示了不同变换选择在实际应用中的性能权衡。

data.abstract: This talk presents several numerical linear algebra problems in electronic design automation (EDA) that we have studied and are currently investigating. These include very large-scale structured linear systems arising in power grid analysis for flat panel display simulation, as well as periodic eigenvalue problems, parameterized linear systems, and preconditioning techniques arising in the periodic steady-state analysis of radio-frequency circuits. Owing to the special design features of integrated circuits, the resulting numerical problems have distinctive structures, properties, and formulations, which pose new challenges to numerical linear algebra.

data.abstract: 自旋电子学能够有效降低电子设备的能耗。近年来,钙钛矿已成为极具前景的自旋电子学材料。钙钛矿自旋电子器件的设计依赖于对自旋弛豫过程的理解与控制,但这目前仍是一项具有挑战性的难题。我们在前期的研究基础上发现了诸如激子结合能及极化子调控等方法,然而目前暂时还无法找到真正的自旋极化调控机制。因此,我们借助机器学习报道了一种用于预测超快自旋弛豫速率的轻量化模型,该模型基于一组本征描述符,这些描述符要么可通过量子化学计算获得,要么可直接从分子组成中推导得出。该模型利用人工神经网络( ANN )构建,并基于一个精心整理的包含 52 种钙钛矿材料的数据集进行训练(其中包括 14 种已合成、表征并通过超快自旋动力学测量进行研究的化合物)。在留一交叉验证( leave-one-out cross-validation )下,该模型实现了极高的预测精度( R ² = 0.99 )。阐明了自旋 - 轨道耦合、声子散射以及电子 - 空穴交换路径的调控如何作为主导自旋退相干的主要机制。本工作为理性开发具有自旋功能的钙钛矿材料建立了一种具有普适性且具有明确物理图像的"合成前"设计策略 。

data.abstract: This talk is concerned with an optimal control problem for a forward-backward stochastic differential equation (FBSDE, for short) with a recursive cost functional determined by a backward stochastic Volterra integral equation (BSVIE, for short). It is found that such an optimal control problem is time-inconsistent in general, even if the cost functional is reduced to a classical Bolza type one as in Peng (AMO 1993), Lim-Zhou (SICON 2001), and Yong (SICON 2010). Therefore, instead of finding a global optimal control (which is time-inconsistent), we will look for a time-consistent and locally optimal equilibrium strategy, which can be constructed via the solution of an associated equilibrium Hamilton-Jacobi-Bellman (HJB, for short) equation. A verification theorem for the local optimality of the equilibrium strategy is proved by means of the generalized Feynman-Kac formula for BSVIEs and some stability estimates of the representation parabolic partial differential equations (PDEs, for short). Under certain conditions, it is proved that the equilibrium HJB equation, which is a nonlocal PDE, admits a unique classical solution. As special cases, the linear-quadratic problem is considered, in which the solvability of a non-local and non-symmetric matrix-valued Riccati equation is established. As applications, a social planner problem with heterogeneous Epstein-Zin utilities is briefly mentioned, by which we show that the Epstein-Zin utility is much more effective than the power utility in this model. Joint work with Qi Lü, Bowen Ma, Jiongmin Yong, and Chao Zhou.

data.abstract: We study a new class of Fourier integral operators defined in R^N. Their symbols are allowed to satisfy a differential inequality with certain multi-parameter characteristic. We prove these operators of order -(N-1)/2 bounded from the classical, atom decomposable H^1-Hardy space to L^1(R^N). As a result, we obtain a sharp L^p-estimate. Simultaneously, a generalized Sobolev L^p-space is introduced. We establish the Sobolev L^p-norm inequality for convolutions with a distribution having singularity on the unit sphere. As an application, we give a new a priori estimate for the solution of wave equations by requiring less regularity on the initial data.

data.abstract: 在全球经济不确定性加剧、破坏性事件频发的背景下,供应链韧性已成为学术界关注的核心问题。人工智能(AI)凭借其强大的数据处理和决策支持能力,被视为增强供应链韧性的关键技术途径。然而,现有的实证研究表明,人工智能应用对供应链韧性的影响存在相当大的分歧,缺乏对研究结果的系统整合和综合。本研究基于2020年至2025年间发表的66项实证研究中的78,887个样本进行了荟萃分析,调查了人工智能应用与供应链韧性之间的相关性。此外,采用亚群分析方法考察了人工智能技术应用程度、供应链整合水平和地理因素的调节作用。

data.abstract: 第二类多铁材料 NiI ₂ 因其自旋序诱导自发极化所产生的强磁电耦合效应,在基础研究与自旋电子学中备受关注。本研究基于第一性原理和对称性约束,构建了包含单离子各向异性、海森堡作用、 Kitaev 耦合及双二次项的自旋哈密顿量,精确再现了其螺旋磁基态特征(如螺旋构型、传播方向);结合广义自旋电流模型、密度泛函理论与紧束缚模型,揭示了磁电耦合微观机制及极化对自旋轨道耦合的一阶依赖关系,阐明了层数限制与磁场对自旋传播方向的调控作用,并预测了涡旋晶体等新奇极化态。特别指出,利用 SpinGNN++ 机器学习框架开发的自旋 - 晶格耦合原子间势,系统研究了扭转双层 NiI ₂ (TBN) 莫尔超晶格:在小扭转角 (~2 ° ) 下,晶格弛豫产生莫尔周期形变(层间距调制 ~0.55 Å ,面内位移达 ~0.48 Å ),协同诱导出离子性面外偶极子与自旋驱动的面内电子极化域,形成自旋螺旋等复杂磁电拓扑序(刚性体系无此现象);与之相对,在近 60 ° 扭转角下,堆叠对称性破缺主导的铁电极移稳定了新颖的极性子 - 反子网络拓扑态。该工作为利用扭转工程调控二维多铁性及设计可编程磁电器件提供了新途径。

data.abstract: Let G be a finite abelian group and M_G the Cayley addition table of G. In this talk, I will discuss several problems on the permanent of M_G (denoted by per(M_G), which is called the group permanent of G). First, we show that the group permanent determines the finite abelian group, which partially answers an open question of Donovan, Johnson and Wanless. Then we discuss the coefficients of monomials occur in per(M_G), a special case of this problem is related to enumerating transversals in the Latin square M_G (asymptotically solved by Eberhard, Manners and Mrazovic using Fourier analysis).

data.abstract: 用统计物理和非线性动力学的观点与方法研究心律失常,已有多年的历史,并取得了丰富的成果。例如认识到心律失常的基本图景是螺旋波斑图,心肌细胞内钙浓度异常增加是二级相变过程等。但由于心律失常的多样性和复杂性,目前仍未形成较清晰的理论框架。随着实验和临床数据的积累,人们已认识到心肌系统是一个多尺度的动力学系统,因此心律失常需从多尺度的观点进一步展开研究,才能有所突破。本报告首先综述心律失常多尺度机制的研究现状,然后介绍我们对其中两个重要理论问题的研究进展:钙电耦合的心律失常机制和群体风险评估的建模计算。多尺度的基本精神是构建模型,把尺度的效应耦合起来,获得跨尺度的关联,进而从系统的角度理解对象的运动性质。我们在这方面的研究工作将有助于心律失常动力学理论框架的建立,并为实际医学应用,例如快速筛查药物毒性,发展出有效的新方法。

data.abstract: 第二性原理计算是一种高效构建原子模型的方法并且被广泛应用于多种铁电钙钛矿材料中。然而,当前的第二性原理计算高度依赖于研究者的个人经验。构建第二性原理模型所需要的训练集,基于获得势能面的第一性原理计算数据,在不同的文献中采用的方法均不一样。到目前为止尚无一种通用且有效的构建第二性原理模型的方法。与此同时,第二性原理计算的精度也高度依赖于训练集的构建方式。针对于这一问题,我们将基于贝叶斯的机器学习算法引入到了第二性原理模型之中,提出了一种利用机器学习自动化实现训练集迭代与模型生成的方法。利用这一方法,我们获得了钛酸钡的高精度第二性原理模型,相比于我们之前在[Physical Review B, 108 134117 (2023)]上发表的工作而言,该模型首次准确的描述了R相、O相、T相的声子谱。随后我们利用这一模型深入的研究了钛酸钡的热输运性质,并发现了R相热导率中较弱的wave-like贡献。

data.abstract: Laser spectroscopy is one of the most powerful tools for studying ground and isomeric state nuclear properties. By observing small changes in atomic transitions, we can deduce the nuclear spin, electromagnetic moments, and changes in mean-square charge radii across long chains of isotopes. This allows us to study how the shapes of the nuclei evolve along the isotopic chain and hence to validate different types of nuclear theories. There are two main techniques in laser spectroscopy setups worldwide. Collinear laser spectroscopy provides exceptionally high resolution, which allows access to electric quadrupole moments, but inevitably, with a significant loss of efficiency. The second approach is the in-source laser method, which has lower resolution but orders of magnitude higher efficiency. With the combination of both highly sensitive radiation detection systems, such as a decay station with various particle detectors, and mass spectrometry devices like MR-ToF, it is possible to study exotic isotopes with extremely low production rates using the in-source method. Over the past decade, an extensive campaign has been conducted at ISOLDE, CERN, studying the structure of the isotopes around the lead region. Results of recent analysis of bismuth and thallium data will be presented, along with the theoretical studies on the shell effects when crossing the Z=82 closure. The prospects for future in-source studies in this region will be illustrated.

The proof is also applicable to $\mathbb{R}^4$ and $\mathbb{R}^5$, thereby providing alternative proofs for those previously resolved cases. data.speakerBio: 黄荣里,广西师范大学教授, 2005年硕士毕业于华南师范大学,2008年博士毕业于北京师范大学, 2008-2010年在复旦大学做博士后。2010年入职广西师范大学。研究方向是偏微分方程与几何分析。在 Calc.Var.Partial Differential Equations、J.Funct.Anal、J.Geom.Anal﹑Int. Math. Res. Not.﹑ Pacific J.Math. M.Z. 等国际著名数学杂志上发表多篇研究论文。

data.speakerBio: 徐洪国教授主要从事数值代数研究工作.博士毕业于复旦大学,师从蒋尔雄教授,博士毕业后获洪堡基金资助,获得Householder奖. 现美国Kansas大学任教。在控制论、结构矩阵、奇异值分解和极分解等数值代数各个领域做了许多很好科研成果. 在知名期刊《Numerishe Mathematik》,《SIAM J Matrix Anal Appl》,《BIT Numer Math》,《Mathematics of Computation》和《Automatic》等发表论文.
data.abstract: For structured matrices, their eigenvalues and invariant subspaces have special symmetric patterns. These symmetric patterns play a fundamental role in applications. We consider two types of structured matrices, the matrices that are Hermitian with respect to an indefinite inner product and the Hamiltonian matrices. Using the recently developed general perturbation theory,we provide structured fractional perturbation results for the invariant subspaces corresponding to the eigenvalues that are perturbed from a single defective eigenvalue of the same first fractional order. Other related results are also provided.

data.speakerBio: 尹思露,杭州师范大学副教授。博士毕业于复旦大学数学系,师从周忆教授。主要研究双曲型偏微分方程解的适定性及奇性理论。在Amer. J. Math、SIAM JMA、JDE等杂志发表多篇论文。
data.abstract: In this talk, we investigate the ill-posedness of the non-strictly hyperbolic compressible ideal MHD (IMHD) system in two dimensions, which exhibits multiple propagation speeds. For scalar quasilinear wave equation, Smith-Tataru showed its local well-posedness in $H^{\frac{11/4}+} \times H^{\frac{7/4}+}$. Here, we construct a counterexample to the local existence of low-regularity solutions to the IMHD system in the borderline space $H^{\frac{7/4}}$. Our proof is based on a coalition of a carefully designed algebraic approach and Christodoulou's geometric approach. We give a complete description of solutions' dynamics up to the earliest singular event, when a shock forms. This talk is based on a joint work with Xinliang An (NUS) and Haoyang Chen (NUS).

data.speakerBio: 徐勇,2022 年博士毕业于德国波恩大学,目前在德国美因茨大学、 Mainz Institute for The-oretical Physics (MITP) 担任博士后,主要从事粒子宇宙学研究。研究内容包括早期宇宙暴胀的粒子物理模型构建、再加热阶段的动力学分析、引力子产生所诱导的引力波理论计算推进,以及早期宇宙中暗物质生成与重子不对称起源新机制的探索。迄今发表研究论文 24 篇,近期荣获加拿大麦吉尔大学 Trottier Space Institute Fellowship (2025 年 10 月份起)。
data.abstract: The well-established theory of Big Bang Nucleosynthesis (BBN) implies that our universe must have been thermalized prior to this epoch. However, cosmic inflation leaves the universe cold and dominated by vacuum energy at its end. The subsequent reheating phase, which connects inflation to the radiation-dominated era preceding BBN,plays a pivotal role in shaping the universe's thermal history. This transition impacts key processes such as dark matter production,cosmic phase transitions, and baryogenesis. Despite its signifi- cance, the reheating era remains one of the most observationally challenging epochs in cosmology. In this talk, I will present recent advances in the study of stochastic gravitational waves (GWs) generated directly during reheating through graviton emission. I will demonstrate how the resulting GWbackground, as part of the landscape of cosmic messengers, offers a unique and direct probe of the pre-BBN universe.

data.speakerBio: 崔希亮,北京语言大学语言学及应用语言学教授,曾任北京语言大学校长( 2005-2017 ),中华炎黄文化研究会副会长,北京语言学会会长,中国语言学会常务理事。现任中国书法国际传播研究院院长,汉语国际教育研究院教授,兼任世界汉语教学学会副会长,北京市语言学会理事长,北京大学校友会副会长。获北京大学文学学士、硕士和博士学位,加拿大麦克马斯特大学人文科学名誉博士、韩国启明大学艺术学名誉博士,罗马尼亚锡比乌卢西安 . 布拉嘎大学、康斯坦察奥维迪乌斯大学名誉博士。主要研究方向为现代汉语语法及汉语熟语,著有《汉语熟语与中国人文世界》、《语言理解与认知》、《语言学概论》、《语言导论》、《汉语作为第二语言的习得与认知研究》等著作,发表论文 110 余篇。
data.abstract: 提要: 人工智能的大语言模型已经深度介入了我们的生活。语言学界开始反思语言学在人工智能背景下的研究范式和研究课题。语言教育领域也开始探讨人工智能如何赋能语言教育的问题。我们主要探讨人工智能如何介入语言研究,以及国际中文教育领域所发生的变化。

data.speakerBio: 周宇,哈尔滨工业大学(深圳)教授,博士生导师,中国科协青年托举人才。本科毕业于西安交通大学,博士毕业于新加坡南洋理工大学(导师高炜博教授),曾任腾讯量子实验室高级研究员。从事通信波段半导体量子光源和自旋比特研究,发表第一/通讯SCI论文11篇 (包括Nat. Commun. 4篇,Sci. Adv. 1篇,Photonics.Res. 封面1篇) 。在量子芯片、量子系统控制等方向授权中国/美国发明专利 10 余项,获得2020年福布斯中国 30位30岁以下精英,主持国自然青年项目、广东省量子科学战略专项重点项目、深圳市重点项目,参与国家科技重大专项青年项目。
data.abstract: 量子光子集成电路正在通过为实用的量子应用提供紧凑、高效的平台重塑量子网络和传感技术。尽管取得了连续的突破,但在CMOS兼容平台上将纠缠寄存器集成到光子器件中仍面临重大挑战。在此,我们展示了单电子-核自旋纠缠及其在碳化硅(SiCOI)波导中的集成。我们成功地产生了单个空位电子自旋和接近100%的单个 13 C核自旋初始化。单个核自旋和电子自旋都可以被相干控制,并且在室温环境下制备了保真度为0.89的最大纠缠态。基于纳米级定位技术,纠缠量子寄存器首次被进一步集成到SiC光子波导中。我们发现,寄存器的固有光学和自旋特性得到了很好的保持,纠缠态的保真度仍然高达0.88。我们的发现突出了SiCOI平台作为未来片上光量子芯片的有力候选者的光明前景,该工作发表在Nature Communications(2024)上,并被科技日报报道。

data.speakerBio: 龚世华, 香港中文大学(深圳)助理教授。本科毕业于中山大学,博士毕业于北京大学。先后在美国宾夕法尼亚州立大学和英国巴斯大学从事博士后研究工作。研究兴趣包括大规模科学计算和数值分析,主要研究有限元方法,线性与非线性预条件子,高频波散射和流固耦合问题的快速求解器。论文发表于Numerische Mathematik, Mathematics of Computation, IMA Journal of Numerical Analysis, M3AS, SISC 等期刊。主持国家自然科学基金青年基金项目、广东省面上项目、深圳市科创委项目、及华为公司应用驱动基础研究项目。
data.abstract: We consider numerical algorithms for particulate flows, which involve the interactions between rigid particles and incompressible flows. In this talk, we will discuss computational challenges for this coupled system, including handling the moving interface between circular particles and flows, and addressing bottlenecks in large-scale and long-duration simulations. Our algorithms use arbitrary Eulerian-Lagrangian mapping to track the moving interface and distributed Lagrange multipliers to enforce the rigid-body motion. The advantages of our algorithms include featuring accurate quadrature, and maintaining a sharp interface, with the potential for high-order methods. At the end of the talk, we will discuss the stability analysis of the variational problems, which leads to robust parallel solvers for the linearized systems. We will also present some simulation results of particulate flows in microfluidics.

data.speakerBio: 史永堂,南开大学教授、博导,教育部重大人才工程特聘教授,数学科学学院副院长。主要研究领域是图论与组合优化。曾获国家自然科学基金优秀青年科学基金项目、天津市杰出青年基金项目等资助;霍英东教育基金会青年科学奖二等奖、中国工业与应用数学学会应用数学青年科技奖、中国运筹学会青年科技奖等。
data.abstract: Let G be a simple graph with the degree sequence $(d_1, d_2, \ldots,d_n)$. Given a positive integer p, denote the sum of degree powers of G by $e_p(G)=\sum_{i=1}^nd_i^p$. The degree power has extensive applications not only in the study of graph structures but also is closely related to graph spectra. In this talk, we show some extremal results on the sum of degree powers of graphs.

data.abstract: 人类对信息的理解和应用是伴随着人类进化和社会发展而不断深入的。现代信息技术, 从电话、电报的发明到互联网的出现, 也仅只有百余年, 但这已使人从对自身的认知到对整个宇宙的了解都发生了翻天覆地的变化,随着信息技术快速发展人工智能的时代已经到来。报告从热力学熵到香农的信息论再到现代的基因编辑和大模型,从特定视角介绍了信息的数学基础和物理属性。报告人将结合自己的学习体会就信息在自然演化和社会发展中的关键作用与听众进行分享与交流。

data.abstract: In this talk, we first introduce some known results on long time behavior of bounded solutions for reaction-diffusion equations. Then, we present our recent results on the long time behavior to a two-species time-periodic Lotka-Volterra reaction-diffusion system.

data.abstract: 量子压缩态在某一个维度上具有较低的量子噪声,已广泛应用于量子精密测量领域和量子纠错领域。然而,生成和操控这类具有高压缩度的非经典量子态通常要求较强的非线性,这不可避免地会引起额外的退相干,从而大大降低量子系统整体性能。在这次报告里,我将介绍我们在超导微波腔中通过放大弱克尔非线性产生的压缩效应来制备具有高压缩度的量子态。通过巧妙地设计失谐微波驱动,我们实验观测了不同光子数Fock态的量子压缩演化的循环动力学过程。此外,我们利用Trotterization技术确定性地实现量子态压缩放大,实现的最大压缩度为14.6 dB,压缩速率为0.28 MHz。这一工作为产生高压缩量子态提供了另一种途径,在量子增强传感和量子信息处理方面具有极大的应用潜力。

data.speakerBio: 王二涛，博士生导师，首批新基石研究员， 获得国自然“杰青”和“杰青延续项目”等资助。长期聚焦植物-微生物共生研究，颠覆了菌根“糖”营养的传统理论，建立了以脂肪酸为核心的营养交换和调控的共生新理论；发现了菌根因子受体和信号转导新机制，开辟植物识别“敌友”微生物的交叉新领域；揭示豆科植物结瘤固氮的新机制并应用于农业生产。研究成果入选2017和2021年中国农业科学重大进展，2021年Cell Press中国年度论文，以通讯作者发表在Science, Nature, Cell, PNAS等国际主流学术期刊上，应邀为Annu Rev Plant Biol, The Plant Cell, Current Biology等撰写综述。担任Plant Cell, Science Bulletin, Science China Life Sciences, New Phytologist, JIPB等学术期刊编委，任上海市植物生理与植物分子生物学学会理事长,中国植物生理与植物分子生物学学会执行秘书长。先后获得 “国家自然科学奖二等奖”（2/4），“中国青年科技奖”，“CSPB杰出青年科学家奖”，“科学探索奖”和“谈家桢生命科学奖”等。

data.abstract: In this talk, we will present the long time regularity of the interface in the $p$-Gauss Curvature Flow with flat sides, in higher dimensions with $p>1/n$. Then, we will talk about a priori estimates of convex solutions to the first initial-boundary value problem of parabolic Monge-Amp\`ere equations without concavity. These studies were done with Prof. Huang Genggeng, Prof. Wang Xu-Jia and Dr. Zhu Ruixuan.

data.speakerBio: 张国华,复旦大学数学科学学院教授、博士生导师,国家优青,本硕博均毕业于中国科学技术大学数学系(现为数学科学学院),博士论文入选全国百篇优秀博士论文,曾相继获得香港求是科技基金会研究生奖、中国科学院院长特别奖、瑞士科技部设立的 2007 年应用数学欧拉奖等。研究方向是拓扑动力系统,主要研究动力系统的复杂性理论和可数离散群作用动力系统的熵理论。曾在Memoirs Amer. Math. Soc., J. Reine Angew. Math., Adv. Math., Ergod. Th. Dynam. Systems, J. Mod. Dyn., J. Funct. Anal., J. Differential Equations等国际权威刊物上发表论文30余篇。
data.abstract: Let (X, G) be TDS with positive topological entropy h, where G is an amenable group. The system (X, G) is called universal if, for any free ergodic G-system (Y, ν, G) with entropy h(ν) < h, there exists an invariant measure µ on X such that the systems (X, µ, G) and (Y, ν, G) are measurably isomorphic. In this talk, we shall report our recent result that a G-subshift with specification is universal if and only if the space contains at least one free element, particularly, any K-shift (consisting of the indicator functions of all maximal K-separated sets) with K finite nonempty is universal if and only if the space contains a free element. This is a joint work with Downarowicz, Weiss and Wiecek.

data.speakerBio: 王治安,香港理工大学教授,华中师大本科硕士。加拿大艾伯塔大学应用数学博士,美国明尼苏达大学应用数学所博士后。主要从事与生物数学相关的偏微分方程研究,兴趣包括生物和生态数学中动力学行为与运动的建模与分析。目前担任J. Math. Biol., DCDS-B, Frontiers in Ecology and Evolution杂志编委。多次获得香港研究资助局基金资助和2022国家基金委-香港研究资助局联合研究基金资助, 获得过2013 JMAA Ames Award 和2019香港数学会青年学者奖。
data.abstract: In this talk, we shall discuss the boundary layer problem of the singular Keller-Segel model with physical boundary conditions in any dimensions. First, we obtain the existence and uniqueness of boundary-layer solution to the steady-state problem and identify the boundary-layer profile and thickness near the boundary. Then we find the asymptotic expansion of boundary-layer profile in terms of the radius for the radially symmetric domain, which can assert how the boundary curvature affects the boundary-layer thickness. Finally, we establish the nonlinear stability of the unique boundary-layer steady state solution with ex- ponential convergence rate for the radially symmetric domain.

data.speakerBio: 崔金涛,暨南大学教授、博士生导师,现任广东省计算数学学会副理事长。2004 年本科毕业于大连理工大学,2010 年博士毕业于美国路易斯安那州立大学。曾任美国明尼苏达大学博士后,美国阿肯色大学小石城分校助理教授,香港理工大学助理教授(研究)。2022年1月就职暨南大学信息科学技术学院。崔金涛博士的主要研究方向为计算电磁场学、偏微分方程数值解法、有限元方法、多重网格方法等;主持国家自然科学基金面上项目2项、广东省自然科学基金面上项目1项、香港研究资助局GRF项目1项;在 Mathematics of Computation、Numerische Mathematik、Computer Methods in Applied Mechanics and Engineering、Journal of Scientific Computing 等计算数学领域高水平学术期刊上发表多篇研究论文。
data.abstract: In this work, we study a new conforming discontinuous Galerkin method for the linear elasticity interface problems with discontinuous coeﬃcients and displacement. This new method is based on a new definition of weak gradient operator and has no stabilizer. The weak divergence operator used in the scheme is diﬀerent from the weak Galerkin finite element method, which significantly reduces the computational cost. The error estimates of optimal order in discrete L2 and H1 norms are established. Numerical examples are presented to demonstrate the eﬃciency and accuracy of the numerical method.

data.abstract: 作为图像处理领域的挑战性课题之一,彩色图像填充问题至今仍面临如何保持各颜色通道之间的相容性、如何克服色彩侵染等难题。本报告将介绍一种新的基于四元数表示的彩色图像非局部重构模型,并从理论上证明该模型能够保持各颜色通道的耦合性。为在求解过程中始终保持各颜色通道之间的相容性,我们提出一类新的调和多辛Lanczos算法,并设计高效的隐式重启动技术。数值实验表明新模型和新算法所恢复的彩色图像具有较高的PSNR值和SSIM值,并且具有较好的视觉效果。

data.abstract: 活的大脑具有复杂多变的内部活动,却可以可靠地产生适应性响应来处理外部信息。因此,一个长期存在的基本问题是:神经网络如何在具有复杂多变的内部活动下产生对外界信息的可靠表征及编码？我们的研究揭示了神经异质性在可靠信息处理中的关键作用,并提出了一个统一的内在动力学机制来阐明各种神经异质性的作用。我们的研究发现神经异质性可以破坏神经网络的内在活动模式,使得神经元的活动更独立灵活、放电率更异质,增强了神经元对外界信号的敏感性,在外界输入的诱导下形成与输入信号对齐的稳定暂态活动模式,进而获得可靠的信息表征。在应用方面,我们提出了一种"预训练储备池组(PRG)"的动作视频识别的新框架,通过认知启发的方式构建网络架构,以基本动作要素作为预训练数据,获得具有吸引子结构的流形表征空间的预训练储备池组,实现高效、可解释的动作表征与识别能力。PRG架构具有高准确率、低能耗、小参数量与小样本学习能力,能够在不重新训练整个网络的情况下适应新任务,适用于资源受限的边缘智能设备。

data.abstract: 有限动量库珀配对是超导性的一种非常规形式,人们普遍认为它需要有限的净磁化。交错铁磁是一种新兴的磁相,它具有特定对称性的高度各向异性的自旋能带劈裂,但净磁化为零。 这个报告里,我将讨论与传统s波超导体连接的金属交错铁磁中的超导库珀配对。 我们发现尽管系统中的净磁化强度为零,但是交错铁磁中由近邻效应诱导的库珀电子对具有有限的质心动量。 这种反常的库珀对动量强烈依赖于库伯对的传播方向,并表现出不寻常的对称模式。 此外,它可以导致多种独特的可观测的物理现象:(i) 交错铁磁中近临效应诱导的局域超导序参量具有高度方向依赖的衰减振荡行为;(ii) 尽管系统净磁矩为零,约瑟夫森超流可以出现可控的0-π相变;(iii) 如果异质结沿着交错铁磁自旋劈裂消失的方向,系统的超导输运性质由沿着大倾斜角度传播的库珀电子对主导;(iv) 沿不同方向的约瑟夫森结展现出不同的夫琅和费衍射模式。

data.abstract: Jets have been pivotal in the advancement of Quantum Chromodynamics (QCD) since its inception, serving as a bridge between collider phenomenology and the formal language of field theory. Modern jet analysis empowers us to achieve significant breakthroughs in our understanding of QCD and enables direct comparisons with experimental data. In this talk, I will outline several key research areas within jet physics that deepen our understanding of QCD. These include deepening our understanding of heavy quark dynamics, investigating the effects of the medium, unraveling the hadronization process, and precision determination of the strong coupling. I will highlight the application of these studies at current colliders like the LHC, RHIC, and EIC.

data.abstract: 非线性光学响应源于非中心对称晶体中的均匀的光吸收,因此通常被认为是所有原子的集体行为。然而与这种普遍预期相反,我们预言在反铁磁体中非线性光学响应可以累积在表面附近,表现出一种趋肤效应。这是因为尽管反铁磁体全局的中心反演对称性被磁性所打破,但在这些反铁磁体的内部,局域层面上几乎不违背这种对称性。以A型层状反铁磁体为例,我们预测空间依赖的非线性光学响应,如体光伏效应(BPVE)和二次谐波生成(SHG),这些效应在顶部和底部层最为显著,并在远离表面时迅速衰减。这种现象存在于中心对称的晶格组成的反铁磁材料中,并且与反铁磁高度关联。我们的工作揭示了非线性光学响应的以前被忽视的一种特性,并为高性能反铁磁的光自旋电子学开辟了新的机遇。

data.abstract: The current NISQ-era has seen so much progress in using programmable digital quantum computers for the simulation of novel physics phenomena in quantum many-body systems [R. Barends et. al., Nat. Comm. (2015); Y. Salathe et. al., Phys. Rev. X (2015); X. Zhang et. al., Nature (2022); A.J. Daley et. al., Nature (2022)]. To this end, these hardware simulations on NISQ devices may serve as a certain kind of unique testbed for exotic phases of matter for a variety of systems. However, finding an appropriate algorithm or framework to properly implement them is not easy. That said, we shall ask ourselves: what is the practical advantage of using a quantum processor for possible prediction/explanation of simulating nontrivial many-body physics? In this talk, I will discuss some of our recent progress along this direction. I will first talk about how we embed a non-unitary operator into a unitary one using an additional ancilla qubit, and how to implement such a unitary operator with quantum circuit recompilation approach using a tensor network-based optimization algorithm. We then apply this approach to two topics: the preparation of the Affleck-Lieb-Kennedy-Tasaki (AKLT) state, and realization of the many-body version of the non-Hermitian skin effect (NHSE), dubbed 'edge Fermi skin' and 'bulk Fermi skin' on a noisy IBM quantum processor. We also show that this works for simulating Hermitian systems, where we focused on a special kind of large-period discrete time crystals (DTCs), as well as for directly probing quantum metric tensor for topological systems.

data.abstract: 二维材料天然具备极限薄的物理尺寸、超快层间电荷转移速率、完备的材料体系,并且其平面结构能够与当代微纳加工工艺相兼容,因此被认为是新一代先进制程芯片用的关键备选材料体系。然而,与传统体材料相比,二维材料在单晶质量、生产效率、结构功能设计方面均具备一定差距,限制了其面向高性能微电子技术的规模化应用。本报告将介绍我们在二维材料表界面制造方向取得的系列进展:包括单层二维材料快速批量制备、叠层二维单晶界面外延制造、光学晶体及光伏转换应用探索。相关研究有望为高性能二维材料器件构筑以及规模化生产提供关键材料技术储备,助力新一代先进制程电子及光子芯片快速发展。

data.abstract: Over the past decade, significant efforts have been devoted to describing and classifying interacting gapped topological phases. However, investigations into interacting gapless topological phases remain very rare. In this talk, I will take a 1+1D exactly solvable model—the cluster Ising model—as an example, combined with my series of work in this newly emerging field, to explain the basic concepts and properties of gapless symmetry-protected topological phases.

data.abstract: Consumption response to permanent and transitory income changes is of central interest in economic studies. Understanding how consumption responds differently to transitory or permanent income changes is important for academia and policymakers. Exploring the prefectural policies that permanently and temporarily increase pension income in urban China, we use a representative monthly panel diary dataset to examine how household consumption responds to transitory and permanent pension increases. We find that, for each pension increase, the reform, on average, increases both permanent and transitory pension incomes among the eligible households, respectively. Based on the responses in the consumption, our estimates yield an estimate of marginal propensity to consume (MPC) being 0.64 to 0.96 but 0.05 to 0.12 for transitory income, consistent with structural estimation. The consumption responses differ by consumption categories. The estimated MPC is much larger among the households with higher liquidity constraints. By contrast, we find no significant changes in other household incomes, including wage, property, business or transfers, or other outcomes such as household size, structure, and individual labor supply. This paper provides novel evidence about different household responses to transitory and permanent income changes and delivers policy implications for predicting dynamic household responses to public policies.

data.abstract: A Hilbert complex consists of a sequence of Hilbert spaces interconnected by a series of closed, densely defined linear operators, such that the composition of two consecutive maps equals zero. The de Rham complex serves as the most prominent example. Finite element complexes arise from discretizing Hilbert complexes by substituting infinite dimensional Hilbert spaces with finite dimensional subspaces, based on a triangulation of the underline domain. This presentation provides an overview of finite element complex construction, showcasing the finite element de Rham complex through a geometric decomposition method. The construction is extended to additional finite element complexes, such as the Hessian complex, elasticity complex, and divdiv complex, using the Bernstein-Gelfand-Gelfand (BGG) framework. The resulting finite element complexes hold potential applications in numerical simulations for the biharmonic equation, linear elasticity, general relativity, and other geometry-related PDEs.

data.abstract: Flat electronic bands near the Fermi level provide a fertile playground for realizing interaction-driven correlated physics. To date, related experiments have mostly been limited to engineered multilayer systems (e.g., moiré systems). Herein, we report theoretical predictions and experimental realizations of nearly flat bands near or even across the Fermi level in monolayer MoTe2-x by fabricating a series of uniformly ordered mirror-twin boundary superlattices (corresponding to a stoichiometry of MoTe8/5 and MoTe56/33). Kagome flat bands were predicted by density functional theory calculations and were discovered by scanning tunnelling microscopy. For the monolayer where a flat electronic band residing across the Fermi level, the partial filling nature of flat bands yields a correlated insulating state exhibiting a hard gap as large as 15 meV. Moreover, we observe pronounced responses of the correlated states to magnetic fields, providing evidence for a spin-polarized ground state. In addition, we also observed a similar geometric symmetry and flat electronic bands in another transition metal dichalcogenide material through lattice distortion induced by charge density wave. Our work introduces monolayer platforms that manifests strong correlation effects arising from flattened electronic bands.

data.speakerBio: 张潇竹,复旦大学理学学士,德国哥廷根大学物理学学士、硕士,马克斯•普朗克动力学与自组织研究所生物与复杂系统物理学博士。2018至2021年在德国德累斯顿工业大学从事博士后研究工作,2022年至今任同济大学物理科学与工程学院副教授。研究方向为复杂网络动力学,包括受驱动网络中的模式形成,复杂网络中的扰动传播过程等。迄今发表SCI论文16篇,包括第一或通讯作者发表的Science Advances, Physical Review Letters等论文。获得马克斯•普朗克生物和复杂系统物理国际研究生院卓越奖学金(Excellence Fellow-ship),并担任期刊Chaos杂志特刊 "Dynamics of Modern Power Grids" 兼职编辑。
data.abstract: 从大脑神经网络到电力传输网络,真实复杂网络系统的功能实现取决于其中大量个体在相互作用的诱导下如何对外界扰动信号如何做出动态的时空响应。然而复杂网络系统在外部影响与内秉性质的共同相互作用下所涌现出的群体动力学行为难以准确描述和预测,至今仍是复杂体系物理学中的一个尚未解答的重要难点问题。我们聚焦电力传输网络这一大型关键基建网络对外界扰动,特别是由风能、太阳能等可再生能源带来的电能输入波动及用户随机行为带来的电能输出波动所引发的分布式、非均匀的动态时空响应行为。我们建立了复杂网络时空响应的普适理论框架,针对稳态响应通过数学解析发现了整体、共振、局域三个重要响应模式,并提出了精确预测网络响应

data.abstract: 量子色动力学( QCD)允许存在由夸克和胶子构成的强子态——混杂态。混杂态一直是粒子物理实验和理论研究的重要对象,实验上多年前观察到的 π_1 (1400) 和 π_1 (1600),以及北京谱仪合作组(BESIII)于2022年首次观察到的 η_1 (1855) 粒子态,都是混杂态的候选者。格点量子色动力学(格点QCD)是研究低能强相互作用性质的重要手段。我们利用格点QCD 研究了轻混杂态以及类粲偶素混杂态的产生和衰变性质,本报告将介绍近期的相关物理结果。

data.speakerBio: 孟增明,山西大学,量子光学与光量子器件国家重点实验,教授,获得国家自然科学基金优秀青年科学基金项目资助。一直从事超冷原子量子模拟的研究工作,主要包括自旋轨道耦合、扭转双层光晶格。已在国内外学术刊物Nature、Phys. Rev. Lett等上发表多篇学术论文。
data.abstract: 扭转双层石墨烯中的强关联量子物态和超导电性激发了人们对基础物理和应用物理研究的极大兴趣。当两层石墨烯叠放在一起,并稍作旋转时,会出现莫尔超晶格结构,这会带来平带结构和许多新奇强关联量子效应。此外,科学家希望将扭转双层系统拓展到新的实验平台,从而为扭转电子学和莫尔超晶格结构开辟一条新的研究途径。该工作采用原子内部自旋态作为合成维度的实验方案,基于玻色爱因斯坦凝聚体实现了自旋依赖的扭转双层光晶格,开展了超流态到莫特绝缘态的量子相变研究,观察到复杂的超流态到莫特绝缘态相变行为。该系统集成扭转双层结构、可调的莫尔超晶格和层间耦合强度以及纯净的环境等特性,未来可应用于不同晶格构型的玻色子和费米子系统,通过这一强大的超冷原子量子模拟实验平台,为研究扭转电子学以及探索其它难以在扭转材料中实现的新奇量子现象打开了一扇全新的科研大门。

data.abstract: 相比传统时间同步，量子时间同步有着潜在的高精度和安全性优势。本报告介绍了中国科学院国家授时中心研究团队在基于频率纠缠源的量子时间同步研究中取得的进展。包括：突破基于二阶量子干涉的时间同步技术，首次实现亚皮秒精度量子时间同步，并首次量化分析了影响基于二阶量子干涉的时间同步系统准确度和稳定度的物理机制；克服了长距离光纤抖动导致二阶量子干涉测量困难的问题，成功将演示距离从4km光纤链路拓展到20km光纤链路上，为更远距离、更高精度的分布式量子时间同步奠定技术基础。提出并基于双向量子时间同步协议实现了20km 光纤上同步稳定度达到 45fs，展现了显著提升经典时间同步技术准确度和稳定度的潜力。将双向量子时间同步技术成功拓展到实地演示验证。在百公里级实地光纤和2km强湍流自由空间链路上实现亚皮秒级双向量子时间传递演示，展示了天地一体光链路中量子时间同步的应用潜力。

data.abstract: Graph products of monoids provide a common framework for direct and free products, and graph monoids (also known as free partially commutative monoids). Much of the existing work in graph products of monoids, and groups, has been to show that various properties are preserved under graph product. In this talk, we will consider certain important algebraic properties of graph products of monoids, such as abundancy, Fountainicity, (weakly) right noetherianity, and residual finiteness.

data.abstract: 透明导电氧化物(TCO)薄膜具有禁带宽、可见光区域透明度高等优良特性，在特定电磁波频率附近，TCO 薄膜会出现介电常数趋近于零（Epsilon-Near-Zero, ENZ）的现象。在 ENZ 材料构成的亚波长厚度的薄膜中，光场可被大大增强，从而诱发一些极端的非线性光学效应。我们研究了 TCO 薄膜的光学非线性响应机制，取决于自由电子加热与束缚电子多光子吸收竞争。针对平面 TCO 薄膜 ENZ 特性的本征偏振和角度依赖特性，提出基于波纹状的 TCO 薄膜可激发空间分离的 ENZ 和 LSPR 共振模式，实现偏振无关及宽角的宽带完美吸收，在 1450—1650 nm 宽波段内实现了响应速度为 350 fs、偏振无关的全光调制。此外，基于波纹状的 TCO 薄膜器件，演示了 1.34μm 波长处的调 Q 输出。上述工作为理解激光脉冲与 TCO 膜之间相互作用的机制，特别是调控自由载流子和束缚电子的动态跃迁行为、增强光子—电子之间的相互作用以及新型非线性光学器件的设计应用开辟了新的机会。

data.abstract: In physics and mathematics, a large class of PDE systems can be formulated as minimizing energy functionals subject to certain constraints. Lagrange multipliers are widely used for solving these problems, which however leads to minmax optimization problems, i.e., saddle point systems. The development of fast solvers for saddle point systems, especially the nonlinear ones, is particularly difficult in the sense that (i) one has to consider the preconditioning in two directions and (ii) the preconditioners have to evolve in iteration due to the nonlinearity. In this work, we introduce an efficient transformed primal-dual (TPD) algorithm to solve the aforementioned nonlinear saddle point problems. We prove the optimal convergence in terms of the condition number. We apply the algorithm to a nonlinear Maxwell equation and show that it is much more efficient than some traditional fixed point and projected gradient descent algorithms.

data.abstract: The extended finite element method (XFEM) is a powerful technique for solving fracture problems with discontinuities, singularities and localized deformations. However, these enrichment functions increase, drastically, the condition number of the stiffness matrix. In this talk, we construct effective domain decomposition preconditioners for elastic crack propagations based on XFEM. A special domain decomposition strategy is proposed. To accelerate the convergence of the Krylov subspace method, the initial guess is built from the solution of the previous system with a local modification in the crack tip subspace. The efficiency of the proposed algorithms applied to problems with several types of cracks are validated by numerical experiments. 学术

data.abstract: 虽然解决不断加剧的环境问题需要全球范围内的集体努力,但最近的证据表明,全球对环境的关注有所下降。因此,研究并确定哪些因素会促进或破坏个人的环保倾向是至关重要的。一些人呼吁对社会文化背景如何影响个人对环境问题的反应这一问题进行更多研究。为了响应这些呼吁,李敏维博士将介绍几项跨文化研究,说明社会文化背景在预测人们对环境问题的反应中的重要作用。具体来说,我们研究了不同的社会文化因素(例如,辩证法和个人主义)在不同背景下对人们的亲环境倾向的影响。我们的研究结果发现,这些社会文化因素直接影响了人们的亲环境倾向,并调节了心理变量和亲环境倾向之间的联系强度。我们还发现,环境行为在家庭环境中的传递在不同文化中是不同的。我们的研究强调了在环境研究中考虑社会文化背景的重要性,这可能有助于在全球范围内更好地培养亲环境倾向。

data.abstract: The Bloch electrons in multi-orbital or multiband systems are not featureless particles. Instead, they generally possess quantum geometric information characteristic of their wavevector-dependent orbital composition. This property manifests in the electromagnetic responses, in the sense that the transport properties of the multiple Bloch electrons at the same wavevector are quantum mechanically interwoven by interband velocities --- quantities that are related to the non-Abelian Berry connection among those states. One part of the quantum geometry, the Berry curvature, has been discussed widely in the context of topological band theories. However, the other part, the quantum metric, which is actually more universally present in multiband systems, has received far less attention. Recently, it was realized that quantum metric is crucial for the existence of flatband superconductivity. This talk will focus on several more novel effects enabled by quantum geometry (mostly quantum metric) in multiband superconductors. We will discuss: A) how quantum geometry induces intrinsic optical anomaly and how this may be related to the anomalous high-frequency spectral change observed in some cuprate and iron-based superconductors; and B) how quantum geometry may facilitate the formation of pair-density-wave states.

data.abstract: 加速器能够将带电粒子加速到很高能量,从而在物理、医学、材料、工业等诸多领域具有不可替代的应用价值。迄今为止,约四分之一的诺贝尔物理学奖与加速器有关。目前全世界约有4万台加速器。随着科学技术的发展,人类需要更多、更强的加速器来满足更多的研究和应用需求。然而,传统射频加速器由于自身原理限制,尺寸规模随着加速能量的增加而增加,高能加速器往往是造价高昂的大科学装置。为改变这一现状,使加速器尺寸更小,造价更低,探索新加速原理迫在眉睫。目前最有希望的一个方向是利用超强激光和等离子体进行粒子加速。等离子体可以承载比传统加速器高几个量级的电场,因此,相比传统加速器,加速距离可以缩小几个量级。本报告将简要介绍相关基本原理,以及我们近期在激光离子加速方面的一些研究进展。

data.abstract: Quantum transduction is an essential ingredient in scaling up distributed quantum architecture and is actively pursued based on various physical platforms. In this talk, I will first briefly introduce the concept of quantum transduction. Then I will discuss our recent approach for transduction, which relaxes the impedance matching condition to half impedance matching condition, and it can be achieved by introducing a two-photon drive in given transducers. We show the transduction channel capacity is enhanced and can be understood in a simple interference picture with the help of Bloch-Messiah decomposition. The parameter regimes with positive quantum capacity are identified and compared with and without the drive, indicating that the parametric drive-induced enhancement is promising in demonstrating quantum state conversion, and is expected to boost the performance of transduction with various physical platforms.

data.abstract: The double copy is currently a highly researched prescription for connecting (non-)abelian gauge theory solutions to gravitational counterparts. In this talk, I will briefly review two types of classical double copy prescriptions---Kerr-Schild double copy and Weyl double copy. A new method for verifying the Weyl double copy relation for non-twisting vacuum Petrov type N and vacuum Petrov type D solutions will be presented. Based on this methodology, I will extend the research to vacuum spacetimes with a cosmological constant and show that the zeroth and single copies satisfy conformally invariant field equations in conformally flat spacetime. In particular, I will demonstrate how the zeroth copy is critical in radiation solution。

data.abstract: 对于地标的使用是空间导航中非常重要的过程,生活中大多数的寻路过程都要借助地标完成。因此,大脑如何处理地标相关的信息以进行导航就是一个非常重要的研究问题。 " 情景假设( contextual hypothesis ) " 是前人提出的一个对此问题的可能解释。该假设认为位于内侧颞叶的旁海马( parahippocampal cortex )对于地标处理和场景的识别都具有重要作用。本研究中,我们构建了一个简单的 3 维场景,以期在仿真的导航环境中对情景假设进行验证。通过分析受试者脑部的功能磁共振影像,我们发现旁海马参与在地标条件下对目标距离的编码。通过表征相似性分析( representational similarity analysis ),我们进一步发现旁海马的活动模式能够解码当前环境中是否存在地标物体。综上所述,我们的研究揭示了旁海马在地标使用过程中的重要作用,为情景假设提供了实证证据。

data.abstract: 薛定谔的猫或为量子力学最为知名的吉祥物:一只既生又死的猫。推广到多体系统,试想象一百只猫处在同生共死的叠加态,这便是著名的Greenberger-Horne-Zeilinger猫态,一种最为典型的具有"长程量子纠缠"的物质态。在量子计算机中制备这样的纠缠态通常需要无穷深的量子线路,然而"测量"可以提供一条捷径,充当胶水快速粘起长程量子纠缠。我们探讨了借助测量来快速制备猫态的方案,围绕一个"量子线路"的数学模型来讨论其物质态的稳定性及量子相变临界现象。研究的难点在于"上帝爱掷骰子":量子态测量的结果具有内禀的随机性,且测量结果彼此关联。我们采取的方案是:(i) 解析地将模型映射到一个经典自旋玻璃中可解的典范问题;(ii) 数值地结合蒙特卡洛+张量网络的方法来在经典计算机中进行大规模数值计算模拟。我们提出的量子线路模型天然地适用于IBM现有的量子计算机,以及里德堡原子平台。在高维空间中,我们甚至可以实现携带无序磁单极缺陷的稳定Z2拓扑有序态(自旋液体)(超导体中的规范电磁场)。

data.abstract: This paper analyzes how economic growth can be caused by changes in the income distribution. Persson and Tabellini (1994) argue that productivity-induced income inequality leads to lower growth since distortionary taxes increase and harm capital accumulation. However, this prediction is often challenged empirically. This paper distinguishes between capital income inequality and inequality induced by differences in labor productivity. Greater capital income inequality leads to lower labor tax rates, leading to higher growth. Using data for OECD countries, subsequent growth is found to be positively related to capital income inequality, and negatively related to labor income inequality, as originally conjectured.

data.abstract: 拓扑物态,包括传统一阶和高阶的拓扑绝缘体和半金属,已成为凝聚态物理和材料科学领域的一个研究前沿。由于宏观特性,光子晶体和声子晶体,即调控电磁波和声波的人工周期结构,正成为探索拓扑物理的理想平台。在本次报告中,我们将主要介绍具有丰富层间耦合的双层声子晶体中的拓扑绝缘体态,包括声学自旋陈数拓扑绝缘体、类塞曼效应诱导的高阶拓扑绝缘体以及混合阶拓扑绝缘体等。

data.abstract: Recently, considerable efforts have been devoted to explore topological phases in non-Hermitian extensions of topological insulators and semimetals. Non-Hermiticity originates from dissipation in open classical and quantum systems, leading to novel topological phases without Hermitian counterparts. One of its salient characteristics is the emergence of exceptional points, i.e., non-Hermitian band degeneracies at which eigenstates coalesce. Noticeably, the non-Hermiticity can alter the nodal structures (i.e., band degeneracies in Hermitian topological semimetals), where exceptional points form new types of topological semimetals. In this talk, I will start with an overview of non-Hermitian phenomena and higher-order topological phases, then present our recent theoretical proposal to realize non-Hermitian higher-order topological semimetals, where we have identified a new type of bulk-band degeneracies, i.e., Weyl exceptional rings in higher-order topological phases.

data.abstract: 精神疾病的神经影像数据库及研究平台是支撑大规模的精神疾病脑影像研究的重要设施,也是实现基于脑影像的诊断和治疗的必要基础。讲者将介绍上海市精神卫生中心建立的跨疾病神经影像平台的构架和功能,以及基于该系统开展的人工智能方面的研究,主要包括:多种精神疾病的影像特征的共性和特异性研究、影像辅助诊断研究等。 焦虑障碍是儿童和青少年时期发病率最高的精神障碍。在这一时期脑的结构和功能均经历快速变化,但脑的发展变化与焦虑障碍的发生和维持的具体关系尚不清楚。讲者将介绍聚焦于儿童青少年焦虑障碍(主要为社交焦虑障碍)与脑的异常变化、成长环境的关系的神经影像研究。

data.abstract: 回音壁模式光学微腔具有很高的品质因子( Q )和较小的模式体积,是研究非线性光学效应的理想微型光学平台。目前,大多研究主要集中在器件本体材料的非线性光学效应及相关的应用。表面材料的引入,通常会导致器件 Q 值的显著下降,因而相关的非线性研究较少。近年来,我们聚焦于高 Q 回音壁模式微腔的表界面,通过精确控制表面单分子层,发展了一种低损耗的表面修饰微腔制备方法, Q 值大于 107 。由此,我们开展了基于单分子层修饰高 Q 微腔的非线性光学研究。本报告将从基本的微腔光学基础入手,介绍我们近来在光参量振荡和拉曼微激光方面取得的进展。欢迎光电、光学、物理、材料、微纳加工等背景的大三学生积极参加。

data.abstract: Humans exhibit considerable variation in how they value their own interest relative to the interests of others. Deciphering the neural codes representing potential rewards for self and others is crucial for understanding social decision-making. In this talk, I will discuss the molecular and neural basis of social decision-making during interpersonal and intergroup interactions. I will first talk about how we integrate computational modeling with functional magnetic resonance imaging to investigate the neural representation of social value and the modulation by oxytocin, a nine-amino acid neuropeptide, in participants evaluating monetary allocations to self and other (self-other allocations). Then I will introduce our recent studies examining the neurobiological mechanisms underlying intergroup decision-making using hyper-scanning, and share with you how we alter intergroup decisions using psychological manipulations and pharmacological challenge. Our results help to better understand the neurocomputational mechanism underlying interpersonal and intergroup decision-making.

data.abstract: 太赫兹波是指频率从0.1THz-10THz(1THz=1012Hz)的电磁波,由于缺乏高效的辐射源、多样化调控的功能器件和高灵敏的探测器,使得该波段成为目前唯一未被开发利用的频段。在这个报告中我主要介绍在辐射源和功能器件方面的最新成果,包括(1)在室温零磁场条件下反铁磁/重金属(NiO/Pt)结构中的THz辐射,根据逆自旋霍尔效应以及一系列的实验证明该辐射来自于NiO中超快自旋流的产生及其向Pt层的注入过程,这个工作为反铁磁自旋电子学、高速安全的存储器件以及新型太赫兹源的研究提供了全新的思路;(2)利用液晶的双折射效应和二氧化钒的相变特性,设计和制备出可调谐的THz超构材料,实现波束扫描器件、宽带和高开比的THz调制器和空间光偏转器件,这些功能器件的开发为未来THz通信和成像技术提供技术基础。

Report recent progress in effective field theories (EFTs) and low energy phenomenology relevant to lepton number violation (LNV) by focusing on the part of contributions that Professor Yi Liao's group has made during the past few years. Start with a brief review on the current experimental bounds on LNV decays, and introduce the basic ideas of EFT. Then describe the current status of the two EFTs that are most relevant to new physics studies, i.e., the standard model effective field theory and the low energy effective field theory. As phenomenological applications, discuss the LNV charged kaon decays that have been computed completely in the framework of EFT and the LNV neutrino-photon scattering that is generally enhanced over the similar standard model processes. The report will be finished with a brief summary and outlook.

data.abstract: 语义记忆是关于客体、文字、事实和人类的一般知识,是大脑的核心认知成分之一。前人研究发现语义知识的表征涉及多个灰质脑区,且脑区间的连接很重要,但是这些连接是如何整合多个脑区的信息来表征语义知识的机制尚不清楚。在本报告中,我们提出并验证了 " 语义可以表征在脑连接中 " 这一新理论。通过使用脑损伤病人数据和机器学习方法,我们发现表征多通道特征的灰质节点之间的脑白质结构连接是天然适合表征语义这种多维空间信息的结构。之后我们通过使用脑磁图和自然语言处理模型对语义表征和整合进行建模,在功能连接的尺度上进一步验证了语义表征的脑连接理论。

data.abstract: Since neural resources are severely limited, the efficient processing of visual information requires selecting only a very small fraction of visual inputs at any given moment in time. Attention is the main mechanism that controls this selection process, namely selective attention. Selective attention is the mechanism by which the subset of incoming information is preferentially processed from the complex external environment. Research on selective attention has two key issues: one is what targets (inputs) are selected by attention. There are three different types of selective attention according to its selected target: spatial, feature-based, and object-based attention; another one is how selective attention generates. There are two different types of selective attention according to its generation source: top-down and bottom-up attention. In this talk , these issues are introduced systematically to explore the neural mechanisms of visual selective attention.

data.abstract: Cognitive control is the ability to withhold an automatic response in favor of a more appropriate but less evident option; consider the temptation to watch the important football game instead of studying for the big exam the following day. Although this type of temptation is (in one form or another) probably very familiar, and a lot of research effort has been spent on its characterization, the mechanism behind cognitive control remains elusive. I discuss how one can (slowly) chip away at the mystery of cognitive control, by attempting to understand it in terms of more familiar and better-understood processes. In particular, I will consider recent modeling and empirical research on how reinforcement learning, oscillations, and probability estimation can be leveraged to ground cognitive control.

data.abstract: This paper explores the relationship between friendship and morality. Two ideas have been influential in the history of moral philosophy: the impartial standpoint and close friendship. These two perspectives on thought and action can conflict, however, and such a case is presented. In an attempt to resolve this tension, and understand the assumptions that give rise to it, I explore an alternative conception of moral conduct and friendship suggested by early Confucian thought. Within this account, moral conduct is that which aims at harmony, understood as the appropriate blending of different elements. This suggests a conception of friendship, ‘event friendship’, which realizes harmony through a focus on shared activities, and the quality of interaction achieved between people as they participate in shared social events. This account offers a novel way of conceptualizing friendship, which also avoids the tension between the impartial standpoint and close friendship.

data.abstract: 语言是思维的载体,是人类得以存在的依据,是民族精神的体现。语言是人类必须面对的最重要的客观现实。语言不仅影响认知,还影响人格。语言中有人格原型、人格理想、人格特质词,有人格形成的途径。双语者掌握两种或两种以上的语言,他们亦有不同的人格,在不同语言的条件下,表现出不同的人格。语言影响人格,必将成为新的重要的研究领域与研究方向。

data.abstract: It remains a puzzle how native banks ( piaohao and qianzhuang ) achieved sustained growth despite the lacking of legal protection in late Qing China. Drawing upon a unique data of native banks in 17 provinces between 1823 and 1911, and the exogenous variations in the appointment of local officials from the Avoidance System, we examine the role of political connections in substituting the missing legal institutions to facilitate banking development. Our results consistently indicate a "regional favoritism" in the officials-banks nexus: the number of bank branches in a province increased significantly after the appointment of a provincial official who was born in the same native province with the bank owner's. The importance of political connections is further evidenced by the finding that regions having produced more high officials experienced a greater decline of native banks relative to other places after the collapse of the Qing dynasty.

The current study tests whether people simulate others' positions in theory of mind. In Experiment 1, we adopted a false belief understanding task from different visual angles to measure whether angles modulate participants' understanding of others' beliefs. In the experiment, one person placed a ball into one of two boxes and left. Then, the ball moved into a different or the same box. The participants inferred in which box the other would seek the ball. Crucially, the results revealed that the participants' responses become worse with the increase of visual angles, indicating that the participants mentally simulate the position of the other in belief understanding. In Experiment 2, we adopted an innovative false belief understanding task to successfully replicate our main findings in the Experiment 1. Results confirmed that the participants indeed mentally simulate the other's position to understand the other's beliefs. The current study suggests that embodied simulation participates in theory of mind.

data.abstract: Psycholinguistic studies that examine the effect of bilingual proficiency have largely focused on the lexical, semantic and syntactic processing whereas those at the text level have received relatively little attention (Tokowicz & Perfetti, 2005). We conducted an event-related potential (EPR) study to examine the proficiency effect on the bilingual (L2) processes of the three levels of text representation (i.e., lexical/conceptual (textbase)/situational, Kintsch, 1998) during the real-time processes of L2 text comprehension. Four-eight English as the second language learners (L2/ESL: high vs. low proficiency, 24 each), read two-sentences passages in English where the "referent-matching" relation of the target word ("The explosion.."), to the text matches with the three levels of text representation: A surface-level match as in "…exploded... The explosion…"; a textbase match as in "…blew up... The explosion…"; and a situation-model match as in "…bomb…dropped. The explosion…". Additionally, a non-sensible baseline "…bomb was stored safely… The explosion…" was used to compare the ease of integration processing among conditions. We analyzed the N400 (250-500ms post-target onset) and late positivity component (LPC, 500-700ms) to assess the proficiency effect on the semantic integration (Kutas & Hillyard, 1980) and the mental-model construction processes (Burkhardt, 2007; Brouwer, et al., 2012) respectively. The results indicate robust proficiency effect when processing textbase match: the amplitude of both N400 and LPC was reduced for high-proficient L2/ESL while enhanced for low-proficient L2/ESL. No reliable proficiency effect was observed when integrating the target word with the text relied on a surface-match and a demanding conceptual processing (i.e., inference-drawing when processing the situation match): both groups showed reduced N400 while enhanced LPC effect. The results, overall, underline the importance of the L2 semantic/conceptual processing in modulating the ease of both meaning integration and mental-model construction processes during L2 text comprehension; and also suggest the high resource constraints in bilinguals' mental-model construction processes due to their non-native lexico-semantic processing (as compared to monolinguals, Burkhardt, 2007; Yang, et al., 2007).

data.abstract: 底特律曾是享誉全球的汽车城,美国第四大城市,成为美国式梦幻城市的象征。然而,由于种族冲突、汽车制造产业衰落和产业转型受阻,昔日繁华已成旧梦,林立的高楼渐成空壳;白人逃离,企业撤退,犯罪高企,底特律被 " 抛弃 " 走向破产,戏称为 " 史上最悲催城市 " 。底特律人口已由高峰期 200 万人骤降至 71 万人( 2010 年),其中非洲裔超过 80% ,失业率高达 40% ,在城市衰败、产业萧条和公共服务紧缺背景中,很多非洲裔女性顽强地寻找机会,积极在非正规部门创业就业,为自己和家庭撑起生存空间。 Swider 教授久居底特律,对此地非洲裔女性就业进行了长期跟踪调查研究,讲座将全景式展示底特律非裔美国女性非正规就业的状况和问题,并探讨底特律城市未来发展的出路。

data.abstract: It is commonly found that pollution intensity first rises with economic growth but then retreats as the GDP per capita reaches a certain threshold, thus supporting the Environment Kuznets Curve (EKC) hypothesis. However, this could merely be an illusion for countries without democracy. In theory, the threshold of the EKC could be too high to reach for countries without democracy even though it is low for democratic ones. Existing empirical evidence, however, largely represents the democratic world due to the systematic lack of pollution data in non-democratic countries. Econometrically, this non-representative sampling may bias the estimates of the EKC for both types of economies. In this study, we propose a solution by employing a unique global air visibility database that covers the entire world. In addition, we apply linguistic diversity as an instrumental variable to address the potential endogeneity in democracy following Barro (1999). Our empirical findings suggest a strikingly large gap between the turning points of the EKC of countries with different levels of democracy. Specifically, although an EKC relationship still exists in weak-democracy countries, their turning points are around US$ 14,000, which double those of countries with a high level of democracy and well above the average income level of the autocratic countries (around US$ 6,800).

data.abstract: People derive positive self-evaluations from personal, relational, and collective identities.Past research has mostly focused onindividuals' evaluations ofpersonal and collective identity, with little research devoted to understanding relational self-esteem.In the research reviewed here, a scale was developed to measure relational self-esteem and the function of relational self-esteem in buffering anxiety and promoting psychological well-being was investigated. Study 1 provides evidence for the reliability and validity of the scale. In Study 2, relational self-esteem was found to serve as an anxiety buffer against the existential fear of death, an d this buffering effect was found to be more salient among collectivists than individualists.Study 3 revealed that relational self-esteem may promote psychological well-being and serve as a mediator between social support and psychological well-being.Taken together, these studies provide unique and emerging findings regarding the development of a theory of relational self-esteem.

data.abstract: 简介: A great deal of research has examined behavioral performance changes associated with second language learning. But what changes are taking place in the brain as learning progresses? How can we identify whether the learner has or has not successfully learned an aspect of the new language? To answer these questions, researchers have developed a variety of methods and paradigms to study the neurocognitive processes of language acquisition. In our research, we have examined the cognitive performance and brain activities associated with second language learning using a fMRI pre-training and post-training paradigm, and attempt to identify the functional connectivity changes over time before and after training on new language vocabulary items. In addition, we identify the individual differences in the participants' cognitive skills, and link these to participants' learning success. Our findings indicate that cognitive skills including working memory and attentional control are positively associated with learning outcomes, and that learners develop more efficient and more integrated brain networks across the left and right hemispheres in key brain areas responsible for phonological and lexical-semantic representation and integration. 在可用于多项选择题的作答方式中,多选一作答方式是最简单常用的答题方式。但是这一方式容易出现猜测答案的行为,被试只掌握部分知识或者根本不知道答案时也有可能选对答案。理论上,意大利数学家De Finetti(1965)提出的确信度作答方式(Probability Testing)是多项选择题的最佳作答方式。该方式不仅可以精确测量部分知识,还能提供被试对各选择项的主观确信程度的信息。这些关于被试的更精确、更详细的信息,在阅读理解、理论思考等高次元能力测量及学习诊断中具有很高价值。在本次沙龙中,将对确信度作答方式的理论与应用作初步介绍。
